name: Sciences Po
summary: Social-sciences college on seven French campuses; English tracks in Le Havre, Menton and Reims, a year abroad, and dual degrees worldwide.

ib.text: An IB student applies through Sciences Po's own international pathway, not Parcoursup. No set subjects or minimum points; predicted grades are assessed.

dates.label: Round 1: apply by 23:59 Paris time for results mid-January
Round 1 interviews begin (they run to 18 December)
Round 2: apply by 23:59 Paris time for results early April
Final round: apply before 1 March (so by 28 February); results at the start of May
Round 2 interviews begin (they run to 19 March)
Final-round interviews begin (they run to 23 April)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts, Asia-Pacific minor (Le Havre)
programmes.about: Law, economics, history, political science and sociology, with a minor on Asia and the Pacific; the third year is spent abroad.
programmes.ib: No set subjects or points; English at C1, tested at interview. French not required.
programmes.selectionNote: File scored out of 50 (exams, record, motivation); those above the yearly bar are interviewed, also out of 50.

family.name: Bachelor of Arts (English track)
family.differs: Asia-Pacific minor, taught in English in Le Havre.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts, Mediterranean and Middle East minor (Menton)
programmes.about: Law, economics, history, political science and sociology, with a minor on the Mediterranean and the Middle East; the third year is spent abroad.
programmes.ib: No set subjects or points; English at C1, tested at interview. French not required.
programmes.selectionNote: File scored out of 50 (exams, record, motivation); those above the yearly bar are interviewed, also out of 50.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts, North America minor or Africa minor (English track) (Reims)
programmes.about: Law, economics, history, political science and sociology, with a minor on North America or the English track of the Africa minor; the third year is spent abroad.
programmes.ib: No set subjects or points; English at C1, tested at interview. French not required.
programmes.selectionNote: File scored out of 50 (exams, record, motivation); those above the yearly bar are interviewed, also out of 50.

family.name: Bachelor of Arts (English track)
family.differs: North America minor or Africa minor (English track), taught in English in Reims.

programmes.name: Dual BA with Keio University
programmes.about: Two years on the Le Havre campus (Asia-Pacific minor), then two years in Keio's economics department in Tokyo; taught entirely in English.
programmes.ib: Apply on Sciences Po's platform before 1 March 2027 (so by 28 February); English at C1.

notes: One application covers up to two programmes; the €150 application fee is not refunded.
Dijon, Nancy and Poitiers teach in French, though B1 French with C1 English lets you start there in English for one semester.
Tuition for students with tax residence in the EEA is set by household income, from €0 to €14,900 a year.
